verdict.rationale: Warp's docs mention running the `warp` agent CLI over SSH (warp-docs-3) but that's about launching an agent conversation, not the terminal itself carrying terminfo, shell integration, and config when SSHing into remote hosts. No evidence describes Warp's terminal propagating its shell integration/terminfo to remote hosts, and community reports (warp-comm-10, warp-comm-14) note broken functionality (file/diff explorer, code indexing) specifically over SSH connections, further indicating the core integration doesn't extend cleanly to remote sessions.
